nodes.role_raw: 4-channel WDM mux/demux (e.g., AWG or cascaded MZI lattice)
nodes.notes: Provide 1 common port and 4 wavelength-selective channel ports. Target equal channel spacing and low inter-channel crosstalk; implementation may be AWG-based or MZI-lattice-based as a single integrated block.

notes: Expose ports as: COM (common) and CH1–CH4 (channel ports).
Define whether used as MUX (CH1–CH4 into COM) or DEMUX (COM into CH1–CH4); device should be reciprocal so either direction works.
